description: Africa - The electricity supply system is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Economics and prices, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Division of Energy Systems Analysis (OpTIMUS). This dataset has been developed by KTH Division of Energy Systems Analysis in the Open Source Energy Modelling System (OSeMOSYS), as further research of the existing TEMBA- model (The Electricity Model Base for Africa). A universal electricity access across the African continent is achieved by 2030 at a specific electricity consumption level. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 3 files in CSV, XLS. The portal files it under Economics and prices, Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
